instruction: I ordered a Room Essentials Stick Table Lamp on amazon for my friend, Aaron, this week, but they don't want it anymore. Initiate a return for it and forward email confirmation containing the return label to them. They live near UPS so it'll be easy for them to drop it.
notes: Apps: amazon (find the lamp order from this week, look up UPS deliverer id, initiate return of quantity 1), phone (search contacts for friend Aaron's email), gmail (locate the auto-generated 'Amazon Return Confirmation and Label' email created by initiate_return and forward that single email to Aaron with forward_email_from_thread, which yields subject 'Fwd: ...' and response_to_email_id set). The return confirmation email only exists after initiate_return, modeled by (return-confirmation-emailed ?o) gating the gmail search. The file_system.File/Directory changes in the evaluation are side effects of the return-label attachment and need no file_system login. Addresses and cart must not be modified. complete_task takes no answer; its record parameters (order, product, deliverer, quantity, email, address) are not API arguments and only enforce that the goal facts hold before completion. Static init facts (order-query, order-contains, confirmation-thread-of, thread-contains, contact-query, contact-email) encode which lookup reveals which runtime id.
